Definition: from G4544 and Θτρᾴκη (Thrace); Samo-thrace (Samos of Thrace), an island in the Mediterranean:--Samothracia.
BiblicalUsage: Samothrace is an island in the Mediterranean, visited by Paul. You find the name in Acts 16:11: "…a straight course to Samothracia, and the next…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Samothrace is on the map because God did his work in real places, not in nowhere. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
